plan.role: Nonformal development pilot of current Section 4.1 on preserved D01/D02 inputs
plan.stopping_policy: Stop an affected task on nonfinite values, nonpositive factors, edge-weight underflow or invalid exact PG shapes; retain all failures. No retry, adaptation, threshold relaxation or old-checkpoint resume. Continue independent registered tasks.
plan.sensitivity_status: Beta(99,1) reserved for a later sensitivity analysis, not run in this baseline pilot.
plan.prediction_status: This pilot evaluates computation and training fit; no held-out predictive comparison until a separate predictive implementation is verified.
plan.graph_policy: Raw full-rank covariance, all K fields, no jitter, no trace normalization, no edge normalization, no clipping or spectral truncation.
plan.initialization_policy: Training-only harmonic feature clustering; occupied starting counts 1/3/7/10 in development; no true labels, future counts, historical fit or checkpoints.
plan.configuration_rationale: rho=1 uses exact integer PG shapes at the smallest initial size. Blocks of 24 observations cover one seasonal cycle and condition on both boundaries. Computational choices are explicit development settings; no outcome-dependent selection.

postprocessing: Deterministic summaries and diagnostics only; no additional draws or chains.
external_inventory_scope: Scientific run files at batch completion, before the later reviewed-summary archive and analysis script were added.
publication_identity: GitHub API publication has different commit metadata, but its complete source tree equals local runtime commit 54c5abdc96b54d6e7bedf946bd98613d4683c8ff.
